title: Implement frozen validation workflows
description:
Authenticated candidate-event identity gates the complete reusable validation suite on the immutable source before any producer is invoked.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workflow consumes the exact candidate-event completion and freeze identities and invokes the reusable normal CI, blocking security audit, workflow-contract, repository-validation, exact-MSRV, and live recency checks with least privilege.
- [hard] REQ-02: Caller, workflow, checkout, repository, event, source, or evidence mismatch fails closed; any validation failure prevents producer invocation and public-channel mutation.
- [hard] REQ-03: One overwrite-forbidden 90-day validation-completed record carries exact run, workflow, source, policy, suite, and parent identities for authenticated producer dispatch.

## Notes

Blast radius: candidate validation-caller workflow YAML and identity/failure fixtures only; producer invocation, artifact creation, root assembly, tags, and public channels are outside scope.
